MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
DEVOPS / PLATFORM ENGINEERING | QA AUTOMATION & TEST INFRASTRUCTURE
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation and test-infrastructure engineer with 7 years of experience, including ownership of CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes-based test environments for three product teams. Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and helped lower flaky test rates from 7% to under 1%. Builds and maintains automation with GitLab CI, Docker, Helm, Python and Bash. Developing infrastructure-as-code and cloud skills through a personal k3s and Terraform project and AWS learning. Currently studying for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam, scheduled for January 2027.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and build tooling: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Containers and orchestration: Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access and test environments), k3s (personal homelab)
Infrastructure as code and automation: Terraform (personal Hetzner VPS project), Ansible (basic), Bash, Python
Cloud learning: AWS (EC2 and S3 basics)
Monitoring and data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Other: Linux, Git, Java (test code)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021-present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage; monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%.
- Built short-lived merge-request test environments with Docker Compose and later Helm on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster; environments include the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, and are automatically removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; flaky test rate fell from 7% to under 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed PostgreSQL test data and built Grafana dashboards for flaky-test metrics using CI results stored in PostgreSQL.
- Wrote an internal guide to CI workflows used in onboarding and mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated approaches.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins nightly regression jobs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal project | 2024-2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

EDUCATION
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam scheduled for January 2027; currently studying

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. In my current test-infrastructure role, I own GitLab CI pipelines and build short-lived Kubernetes test environments for three product teams. That work has given me practical experience automating deployments, improving repeatability and helping developers test changes in environments close to their service workflows.

I have reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes, and built merge-request environments using Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster, with PostgreSQL, seeded data and automatic cleanup. I also wrote the internal guide to our CI workflows used in onboarding. These projects have required me to make infrastructure easier for teams to use and to work across QA, product and development needs—experience I would bring to supporting backend developers and keeping a platform approachable and observable.

I am building further infrastructure experience through a personal three-node k3s cluster managed with Argo CD, with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring. I have also provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform. My professional Kubernetes work is at namespace level, and my AWS experience is currently personal learning covering EC2 and S3 basics. I am studying for the CKA exam, scheduled for January 2027.

Corvale's work to connect a new train fleet with its cloud platform makes this a distinctive infrastructure challenge. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my CI/CD and test-environment experience could contribute to the team, while I continue developing toward cloud and platform engineering.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
